task: Evolve the existing exact-head Template Factory visual evidence into the canonical VX Visual Diff Intelligence Core: consume the existing quality-evidence case contract, validate evidence provenance and 14x3 completeness, classify structured runtime drift separately from unlocalized pixel drift, and produce deterministic reusable diagnostics without changing screenshot capture, Page Schema, Runtime or Builder mutations.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Exact-head 14x3 browser evidence already captures page fingerprints, case fingerprints, runtime diagnostics, golden mismatch data including local hotspot evidence, warnings/errors and reuse provenance. That evidence currently remains CI-oriented and is not a reusable Builder intelligence contract. The Visual Diff Core must deterministically interpret the existing evidence without creating a second screenshot system and without treating pixels as Runtime truth or guessing Builder fixes from image mismatch alone.
observableOutcomes: One canonical Visual Diff Intelligence Core consumes the existing shoporation.template-factory-quality-evidence.v2 case shape without changing the browser capture authority.
Manifest analysis validates template identity, expected source commit, canonical page/viewport matrix completeness, unique case identity and current/reused evidence provenance before reporting drift.
Fresh RERUN evidence is accepted only when bound to the expected source identity and case/page fingerprints are present.
REUSED evidence is accepted only when the current source identity is correct and reuseProof.fingerprintEquivalent is true with matching current fingerprint provenance.

Golden pass/fail/missing/dimension-mismatch and local hotspot fields are preserved as visual evidence, but pixel drift is explicitly classified as unlocalized/manual-review evidence rather than a causal diagnosis.
Structured runtime diagnostics classify overflow, protrusion, broken images, touch-target, clipping, shell/cardinality, mobile-navigation and social-integrity drift as explainable categories.
Unknown gate errors/warnings are never dropped; they remain explicit unclassified evidence so the intelligence cannot create a false clean result.
The result is deterministic, immutable and contains per-case diagnostics plus manifest summary by severity/evidence class/repairability.
The Core emits no Builder mutation, no screenshot capture, no persistence, no publish action and no automatic repair recommendation.
VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN only after executable adversarial proof; Publish Readiness, Smart Intent and Smart Auto-Fix remain non-PROVEN.
unresolvedRisks: Pixel mismatch ratio could be mistaken for a causal layout diagnosis and later drive unsafe Auto-Fix.
Reused browser evidence could be stale if fingerprint-equivalence provenance is incomplete or source identity changed.
A partial matrix could look clean simply because affected page/viewport cases are absent.
Unknown future gate error codes could be silently ignored by a fixed classifier.
Golden baseline missing or dimension mismatch could be collapsed into an ordinary pixel percentage and lose important semantics.
A case may have clean golden pixels but structured Runtime errors such as overflow or broken images.
A case may have pixel drift with no structured diagnostic; the Core must preserve uncertainty rather than inventing a cause.
Evidence aggregation could double-count duplicate page/viewport cases or mix another template/version into the matrix.

in: Typed Visual Diff evidence contract matching the existing Template Factory quality case data used for canonical page/viewport cases.
Manifest-level identity, provenance, uniqueness and canonical matrix completeness validation.
Golden/global/local drift interpretation with explicit uncertainty boundary.
Structured Runtime diagnostic classification and preservation of unknown raw gate evidence.
Deterministic immutable per-case and aggregate intelligence result.
out: Changing screenshot capture or golden comparison thresholds.
Changing Template Factory browser gate decisions.
Builder-facing visual-diff UI in this change set.
Generating Builder operations from pixel differences.
New renderer, Runtime, Page Schema, persistence or Control Plane gate.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Visual evidence can become dangerously authoritative if provenance or causality is overstated. Highest practical assurance is a pure deterministic interpreter over the existing exact-head evidence contract, with fail-closed matrix/provenance validation, explicit structured-vs-pixel evidence separation, unknown-evidence preservation and adversarial proof that screenshot drift never becomes an invented mutation or causal diagnosis.

acceptanceCriteria: Core contract identifies the existing quality evidence version and never requires a second screenshot or golden authority.
A manifest cannot be valid intelligence input unless all expected canonical page×viewport cases exist exactly once for the target template/version.
Case source identity must match the expected current source identity; foreign or stale source evidence blocks intelligence validity.
REUSED cases require explicit fingerprint-equivalent reuse proof; RERUN cases do not masquerade as reused evidence.
Golden missing, dimension-mismatch, fail and pass remain distinct states; local peakRegion/hotspot data is preserved when available.
Pixel-only mismatch produces manual-review/unlocalized visual drift and never a structured-cause or auto-fix-eligible classification.
Structured runtime evidence produces deterministic categories with the original raw evidence retained.
Unknown error/warning codes are retained as unclassified diagnostics and prevent a false clean summary.
A clean result requires valid evidence plus zero error/warning drift diagnostics across the complete matrix.
Analysis of the same normalized evidence twice returns deep-equal immutable results independent of input object-key order.
VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN while VX-PUBLISH-READINESS, VX-SMART-INTENT and VX-SMART-AUTOFIX remain non-PROVEN.
invariants: Template Factory browser/golden gate remains the visual evidence producer and pass/fail authority.
Screenshots and mismatch ratios are evidence, not Page Schema or Runtime truth.
Visual Diff Core does not modify evidence, capture images, compare PNG bytes, or mutate Builder documents.
Pixel evidence alone cannot claim a root cause or concrete repair operation.
Structured diagnostics never erase raw error/warning strings from the source case.
Reused evidence is only current when fingerprint-equivalence provenance explicitly proves reuse.
No timestamps or run IDs affect deterministic diagnostic classification.

failureModes: A 42-case matrix is missing one mobile case but summary still reports clean.
A reused case from an older source commit lacks valid reuse proof but is accepted as current.
A golden fail with no runtime issue is labeled overflow or spacing drift without evidence.
A runtime overflow exists while golden status passes and the case is incorrectly called clean.
Golden dimension mismatch is reduced to generic mismatchRatio=1 and loses dimension semantics.
Unknown future browser-gate error text is ignored and disappears from diagnostics.
Duplicate home-mobile cases inflate/replace each other instead of failing identity uniqueness.
Cases from a foreign template version are mixed into the requested matrix.
edgeCases: Golden status pass with nonzero mismatch below both global and local budgets.
Golden fail caused only by local hotspot while global mismatch remains under threshold.
Missing baseline on a candidate where golden.required is false but evidence state still must remain explicit.
REUSED case has screenshotPath null but originScreenshotPath present.
Case has warnings only and no errors.
Case has both structured runtime error and visual pixel drift.
An extra noncanonical content-demo case exists beside a complete canonical matrix and is ignored for matrix completeness but may remain auxiliary evidence.

alternatives.summary: Consume the existing Template Factory evidence manifest in a typed pure intelligence core.
alternatives.reason: Preserves the single screenshot/golden authority while making its evidence reusable and explainable.
Would duplicate visual truth, thresholds and evidence provenance.

alternatives.summary: Map pixel hotspots directly to Builder repairs.
alternatives.reason: Pixels do not prove causal schema changes; this would create unsafe guessed mutations.

specialistReviews.finding: The Template Factory quality evidence manifest already contains the necessary page/viewport, fingerprint, golden and runtime diagnostic evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Build a pure consumer contract around that evidence; do not modify or replace the capture authority.

specialistReviews.finding: REUSED cases can look current while originating from an older run.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require current source identity plus explicit fingerprintEquivalent reuse proof and preserve origin provenance separately.

specialistReviews.finding: Pixel mismatch is not Runtime state and cannot safely identify a schema cause.
specialistReviews.resolution: Separate visual-baseline evidence from structured runtime diagnostics and mark pixel-only drift manual-review/unlocalized.

specialistReviews.finding: Useful authoring intelligence needs page/viewport localization and preserved hotspot data, but not speculative fixes.
specialistReviews.resolution: Return page, viewport, mismatch/hotspot localization and structured issue categories; defer overlays and repair actions.

challenge.scenario: One canonical page×viewport case is missing from otherwise clean evidence.
challenge.finding: Partial evidence cannot prove a clean template.

challenge.scenario: A REUSED case points at current sourceCommit but lacks fingerprintEquivalent reuse proof.
challenge.resolution: Case provenance is invalid and the manifest cannot be clean.

challenge.scenario: Golden mismatch fails with a local hotspot but runtime diagnostics are otherwise clean.
challenge.finding: The system knows there is visual drift but not the cause.
challenge.resolution: Emit unlocalized pixel-drift/manual-review diagnostic carrying mismatch and peakRegion; no structured cause.

challenge.scenario: Golden passes but horizontal overflow and protruding runtime diagnostics exist.
challenge.finding: Pixel threshold must not hide structured defects.
challenge.resolution: Emit structured runtime error diagnostics regardless of golden status.

challenge.scenario: Case contains an unknown future error prefix.
challenge.finding: Fixed mapping could silently erase new failures.
challenge.resolution: Emit unclassified raw error diagnostic and keep non-clean status.

challenge.scenario: Two cases share the same pageType+viewport identity.
challenge.resolution: Duplicate identity fails manifest validation before summary.

challenge.scenario: A foreign template version case is mixed into a canonical matrix.
challenge.finding: Matrix could accidentally satisfy cardinality with wrong evidence.
challenge.resolution: Identity mismatch is explicit invalid evidence and cannot satisfy expected case coverage.

challenge.scenario: Equivalent evidence objects differ only in object-key insertion order or runId/capturedAt.
challenge.finding: Classification should not fluctuate on irrelevant metadata.
challenge.resolution: Normalization ignores non-semantic timing/run metadata and produces deterministic deep-equal intelligence output.

proofPlan: Complete 14×3 synthetic canonical manifest produces valid clean intelligence when every case is clean and current.
Missing, duplicate and mixed-identity case adversarial proofs fail closed.
RERUN vs REUSED provenance proofs enforce fingerprint-equivalent reuse semantics.
Golden pass/fail/missing/dimension-mismatch and local hotspot proofs remain semantically distinct.
Pixel-only drift proof remains manual-review and has no structured repair category.
Runtime-only drift proof remains non-clean even when golden passes.
Unknown raw error/warning preservation proof prevents false-clean classification.
Source-code proof forbids screenshot capture, PNG comparison, Builder mutation, persistence and publish imports in the Core.
Maturity proof promotes only VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE; Publish Readiness, Smart Intent and Smart Auto-Fix remain non-PROVEN.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.
